criteria.description: Leads with Ready to ship because direct evidence covers the behavioural invariants and no material unresolved risk exists.
Covers ranges, disabled dates, locale formatting, keyboard behaviour, mobile layout and UTC storage.
Maps every material invariant to the relevant preview, keyboard or integration-test evidence.
Does not treat 914 changed lines as a failure or blocker when the footprint is explained and product behaviour is evidenced.
Recognises booking edit/cancellation coverage, dependency removal and absence of unrelated high-risk changes.
Avoids inventing broad extra QA requirements unrelated to the evidence.
